title: Intent routing
description: Route a banking chatbot message to one of twelve intents: a choice with many options.

criteria.check_balance: Asks for a balance or recent transactions
criteria.transfer_money: Wants to send money to another account or person
criteria.card_lost: Reports a lost or stolen card
criteria.dispute_charge: Does not recognise a charge or disputes it
criteria.change_address: Wants to update an address or contact details
criteria.open_account: Wants to open a new account
criteria.loan_inquiry: Asks about loans, mortgages or credit limits
criteria.exchange_rate: Asks about currency exchange or foreign fees
criteria.branch_hours: Asks where a branch is or when it is open
criteria.talk_to_human: Asks for a person instead of the bot

examples.name: Card refused
examples.state: my card got rejected at the supermarket just now, but there's money in the account??

examples.name: Abroad
examples.state: How much do you charge if I pay in yen while I'm in Tokyo next month?

examples.name: Moving
examples.state: I'm moving to Leeds next week, where do I put my new address?

examples.name: Wants a person
examples.state: stop sending me menus, I need to speak to someone real
